blurb: Vitalik Buterin is the co-founder of Ethereum, the leading smart contract blockchain. He is a prominent figure in the crypto space, known for his deep technical insights and philosophical writings on decentralization, governance, and Ethereum's roadmap. His X account shares updates on Ethereum development, layer-2 scaling, and broader crypto ecosystem trends, with over 5 million followers.
credibility_note: As Ethereum's co-founder, Vitalik is highly credible on blockchain technology, though his views may reflect a pro-Ethereum bias. He has a strong track record of accurate technical predictions and transparent communication.
